name: subscribe_github_pr
description: Subscribe this conversation to future GitHub pull request events. Not delivered: PR lifecycle events that echo this agent's OWN actions — Cursor-actored events on this agent's own working branch (its own pushes/synchronize, PR-body edits, closes) — and metadata-only churn (edited titles/bodies, labels, milestones, assignments, merge-queue and auto-merge toggles). Always delivered: all comments, reviews, and review comments — including Bugbot and Agentic Security Review activity, which shares the cursor[bot] identity — plus lifecycle events actored by humans or on any other branch. A PR-scoped subscription (scope: pr) closes itself once the PR is merged or closed. After subscribing, state what you are waiting for and end your turn; the event arrives as a follow-up notification in this conversation.

keepWatchingAfterClose.description: Only for scope: pr. By default a PR subscription closes itself when the PR is merged or closed. Set true only when the user explicitly asked to keep watching this PR after it is merged or closed (e.g. for post-merge review comments). Ignored on other scopes.
